clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore, the Bottom of Gelkak's Key is one of three fragments of a shattered winding key. It belonged to the shipwrecked gnome pirate Gelkak Gyromast, and reef crawlers scavenged it from the shore.

Threshadons sank Gelkak Gyromast's ship off Darkshore, casting the gnome and his belongings ashore. Among them was the winding key that activated his mechanical first mate. The key broke against the coastal rocks into three pieces, and local scavengers descended on the debris. Reef and tide crawlers seized the bottom fragment as they searched the tideline.
